findings.defect: The creed says heaven and earth, not heaven both above and below.
findings.rationale: 천상천하 refers to heaven above and the world below.

findings.current: Only after driving his sword into the man’s chest did the follower’s words finally stop.
findings.defect: The sentence makes the follower appear to drive the sword into his own chest.
findings.rationale: The Sword Lord stabs the follower to silence him.
findings.replacement: The follower’s words stopped only when the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord drove his sword into the man’s chest.
findings.source: 가슴에 검을 꽂고 나서야 우뚝 끊기는 교언.

findings.current: Then, at last, the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord recognized the source of his unease.
findings.defect: Unease replaces the specific sense of déjà vu.
findings.rationale: 기시감 is a feeling of having encountered something before.
findings.replacement: Then, at last, the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord understood why this felt familiar.
findings.source: 순간, 풍운검군은 그제야 이 기시감의 정체를 알아차렸다.

findings.current:
He barely steadied himself, pain like a stab piercing his wrist.

The impact itself was beyond comparison.
findings.defect: The second sentence reads as another physical impact rather than the far greater shock he feels at his opponent’s strength.
findings.rationale: The shock is compared with his wrist pain and leads directly into his stunned recognition.
findings.replacement:
He barely steadied himself, pain stabbing through his wrist.

Far worse than the pain was the shock.
findings.source:
손목을 찌르는 듯한 통증을 느꼈다.

그와는 비교도 할 수 없을 만큼, 엄청난 충격도 함께.

findings.current: Someone not stronger than anyone else in the world, but who had always brought winds of change no one could have predicted.
findings.defect: Not stronger than anyone else can suggest he is weaker than everybody, rather than simply not the strongest.
findings.rationale: The Korean denies that he surpasses everyone; it does not place him below everyone.
findings.replacement: Someone who wasn’t the strongest person in the world, but who had always brought winds of change no one could have predicted.
findings.source: 천하의 그 누구보다 강한 것은 아니지만, 지금껏 언제나 그 누구도 예상치 못한 변화의 바람을 불어왔던 누군가를.

findings.current: The flash of its blade flew straight for the enemy’s forehead.
findings.rationale: 미간 specifies the space between the eyebrows.
findings.replacement: The flash of its blade flew straight for the spot between the enemy’s brows.
findings.source: 그 섬광의 종착지는 정확히 적의 미간을 겨누고 있었다.

summary: The main defects are an impossible subject in the chest-stab sentence, a mistranslated creed, and wording that obscures the Sword Lord’s shock and his assessment of Jin.
